title: Payment ask
description: The provider's own request to be paid before it approves a run, sent with run_decide payment_needed and passed to the consumer in run.payment_needed. The payment happens on the provider's page or processor, never through the network. The link must be https, on the provider organization's verified domain or a payment processor the network recognises; put the reservation_id in it to match the payment to the run.

url.description: The https page where the consumer pays the provider.

amount.description: What the provider asks, as a decimal string, e.g. "40.00". It may cover more than this run, such as a pack or a subscription.

description.description: What the payment is for, in plain words.

challenge.description: Optional, at most 4 KB: the provider's payment processor's machine-payable request, passed on unread so a consumer runtime can pay it within its own rules.

host.description: Set by the network: the link's host name.

provider_verified.description: Set by the network: true when the link is on the provider organization's verified domain, false when it is on a recognised payment processor.
